changes: Table > Table options opens provider-shaped Column, Row, Cell and Color sections.
Column width, minimum row height, cell padding/alignment, borders and background use native field-masked batch updates scoped to selected cells and document tab.
Native rendering includes column widths, row height, padding, borders, alignment and background. Cell styles do not leak into text formatting.
Enter/blur commits deduplicate changes; invalid input restores saved values with actionable feedback.
Desktop sidebar and mobile bottom panel retain a visible close button; switching tabs closes stale controls.
Width validation enforces the documented 5-point minimum in UI and API, with atomic rollback of an invalid native batch.
Border writes propagate to the neighboring shared edge, preserve unrelated border fields, follow Right/Left/Bottom/Top precedence and skip invisible merged-cell boundaries.
